flag_selection.choice: For nonempty lairs: nearest held lair by f32 sqrt((home_x-player_x)^2+(home_y-player_y)^2), comparing with f32 total_cmp; ties retain first. If none held, earliest respawn_at by f32 total_cmp; ties retain first. Zero lairs leaves prior initial None selection.
flag_selection.storage: Selection always stored Some(zero_based_index), irrespective of show_flag. Spawning a guardian clears selection first at145910af7 then this same tick recomputes it.
flag_selection.presentation_limit: Guardian map flag packet lifetime and announcements are separate from exposing selected index on AZSLAIRS; this contract does not claim their UI parity.
flag_selection.update_gate: Recompute on playing-phase native tick only, except showcase Game+a6c. Other phases bypass the selector and preserve its cached value; before the first selection it is None. A zero-delta playing tick can still select, so clock>0 is not an exact initialization guard.
